verdict.rationale: Stripe documents stablecoin (USDC) payouts from a Connect platform to its connected accounts, with Stripe handling fiat-to-USDC conversion. That covers the disbursement use case of paying many recipients. However, nothing in the pack shows a batch or bulk payout API that submits many payouts in one operation, or that reports per-item status. Missing for 10: a documented batch/bulk payout endpoint, per-item status reporting for batch payouts, bulk fiat payout coverage, and independent or hands-on corroboration of mass-disbursement workflows.
